output.summary: Two signature changes with callers. tax() in tax.py gains a rate parameter (default 0.1), and the Python callers in orders.py and refunds.py now pass 0.2. formatPrice() in src/price.ts gains a currency parameter, and four TypeScript callers now pass 'USD'. Unrelated edits: a hardcoded tax argument in calc.py, a method call in fmt.ts, a legacy label text change, and config.json switching currency from USD to EUR. The callers still hardcode 'USD' while the config now says EUR. The reviewer should confirm whether that is intended.

groups.title: tax() gains a rate parameter
groups.description: The definition adds rate with default 0.1 and multiplies by it. Read it first; the default keeps old single-argument calls working.

groups.title: Python callers pass a 0.2 rate
groups.description: order_total and refund now pass 0.2 explicitly, so they no longer use the 0.1 default. Check that 0.2 is the intended rate for both.

groups.title: formatPrice() gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The function now requires a currency string and returns it as a prefix. Output changes for every caller, since the value is no longer a bare number.

groups.title: Callers pass 'USD' to formatPrice()
groups.description: Four summaries and aliasCaller now pass 'USD'. Check that none should use another currency, and that config.json's EUR setting does not need to reach them.

groups.title: Unrelated edits
groups.description: These changes do not follow from the two signature changes. calc.py and fmt.ts call a method of the same name on a different class, so they are not callers of the changed functions. legacyLabel uses the legacy formatter. config.json switches currency to EUR. Review each on its own.

edgeVerdicts.reason: viaMethod calls formatPrice as a method on an Fmt receiver, which is Fmt.formatPrice in fmt.ts, not the exported function changed in price.ts.
use_calc calls tax as a method on a Calc() instance, which is Calc.tax in calc.py, not the module-level tax function changed in tax.py.

inferredRelationships.explanation: config.json now sets currency to EUR, but checkoutSummary hardcodes 'USD'. The reviewer should check whether the config is read anywhere that these callers should follow.
